provenance: Assistant-authored fictional training questions, 2026-11-05; not authentic adjuster questions.

cases.question: What does EX-WEAR-01 exclude?
cases.needle: Gradual deterioration, corrosion and ordinary wear are excluded.

cases.question: Does EX-FLOOD-02 treat a pipe escape as external flooding?
cases.needle: An escape from an internal water pipe is a different cause

cases.question: What evidence is needed under EX-DELIB-03?
cases.needle: Suspicion alone is not proof of deliberate conduct.

cases.question: What deductible applies with END-GLASS-04?
cases.needle: reduces the glass-only deductible to 100 currency units.

cases.question: What is the standard motor deductible?
cases.needle: standard accidental vehicle damage deductible is 500 currency units.

cases.question: What is the home water damage deductible?
cases.needle: home escape-of-water deductible is 750 currency units.

cases.question: When must accidental motor damage be reported?
cases.needle: within seven calendar days of discovery.

cases.question: When must a home pipe leak be reported?
cases.needle: within fourteen calendar days of discovery.

cases.question: What documents are needed for a motor repair claim?
cases.needle: damage photographs and an itemized repair estimate.

cases.question: Does a closed claim mean coverage is approved?
cases.needle: closed never means approved by itself.

cases.question: Which policy edition applies to an earlier loss?
cases.needle: effective on the date of loss.

cases.question: How should pre-existing damage be checked?
cases.needle: Compare dated photographs and inception records
